# Ginés Sánchez

> Ginés Sánchez builds software and companies at Alteridad, making it cheaper
> to turn what an organisation knows into action.

Ginés builds software and companies at Alteridad. The work makes it cheaper to
turn what an organisation knows into action—and what happens next into a
better decision: truth easier to recover, decisions easier to explain, and
consequences harder to ignore. Better systems should make good work easier—and
corruption harder. The long game is to make it easier to create value together
than to take it from somewhere else.

## Selected work

- Culture Decides: notes toward a book (September 1, 2026).
- [Alteridad](https://www.alteridad.org/): software and company building.
